body.query: How much did HappyRobot raise in its latest funding round?

results.title: We've Raised $150 Million in Series C Funding | HappyRobot
highlights:
We've Raised $150 Million in Series C Funding | HappyRobot
...
We're excited to share that we've raised $150 million in Series C funding, led by Prysm Capital and co-led by Eurazeo. Existing investors a16z, Base10, and Y Combinator are doubling down, joined by strategics including Koch Disruptive Technologies (KDT), Kfund, Orange, T.Capital (Deutsche Telekom), Bankinter, Endeavor Catalyst, and Wave-X.
...
This round values us at $1.2 billion post-money, bringing our total funding to around $200 million as we enter a new stage of growth, deploying our AI agents across more of the mission-critical work enterprises can't afford to get wrong.

results.title: HappyRobot raises $150M at $1.2B valuation to bring AI agents to critical enterprise work - SiliconANGLE
results.author: Kyt Dotson
highlights:
HappyRobot Inc., a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence startup that automates enterprise operations, said today it raised $150 million, led by Prysm Capital and co-led by Eurazeo, bringing the company’s post-money valuation to $1.2 billion.
...
Existing investors a16z, Base10, Y Combinator joined venture capital firms Koch Disruptive Technologies, Orange, T.Capital, Bankinter, Endeavor Catalyst, Kfund and Wave-X in the Series C round. Today’s round brought the company’s total funding to around $200 million, including$44 million in Series B raised in September.

results.title: a16z-backed HappyRobot joins unicorn club after $150M funding round — TFN
results.author: Sofia Chesnokova
highlights:
# a16z-backed HappyRobot joins unicorn club after $150M funding round
...
- HappyRobot raised $150 million in Series C funding, led by Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. The company is now valued at $1.2 billion.
- In 2022, three Spanish founders moved on from a discontinued computer vision startup to focus on AI voice agents.
- The company is now expanding beyond logistics into insurance, energy, telecommunications, and airlines. It is positioning itself against competitors like Parloa and Sierra.
